note: Fight it out (brief 018 §5), the loud twin of loud: the police never break, so once the response unit is down the Scout and Tech close on the officers at the café wall and the cell downs them all; then the three board after the Enforcer (the seal clock runs: anyone left standing would be captured). Nobody is up to see the car go. The loud front (GDD §07 loud; Keel N10): loop the camera and reroute the patrol, shoot the guard just after his 2:30 check-in mark, enter (68 s at Alert 2), take Vale out and fight the police at the getaway car with the whole armed cell. No contact. The Tech and the Enforcer run (free once the run is loud; before it, noticed). Once the guard is shot the Scout, Fixer and Tech run to cover by the car and draw; the Enforcer brings Vale to the car under their cover. Re-sited 2026-10-19 (Waymark, brief 023; Sky's door option (b)): the response unit now walks from the north street along Rocket Lane past the getaway car to the public door on the west face, so the Scout and Fixer keep their weapons holstered in cover until the final fight (drawn, they were seen by the passing officers and the fight began at the car before the Enforcer was out); they draw and fire at will when it opens, as the Tech does. The close on the café wall once the response unit was down is gone: from the cover by the car the cell downs both officers, and walking out at them got the Scout and the Tech downed. Brief 027 (Waymark, 2026-10-21; engines 0.17.0 and 0.18.0, tuning.md §11-§13: police answer every operative who fired on them in the last 3 s, so they no longer flip between the cell's shooters): the three wait behind the getaway car instead of the car's east end and the pavilion piers (there the passing response unit downed the Scout at 2 m and the Fixer had no line past his pier), and fight with locks: as the doors open all three lock the nearest officer of the response unit, then, once it is down, the blocker. Focus is what wins it: the same waits firing at will leave an op behind or fail in 26 of 48 half-metre and metre moves of one wait (engine 0.18.0), with the locks in 11 of 48; the first locks must be given within 0.5 s of the doors opening, so pause (briefs/027/waymark/loud-robust-0.18.txt). Brief 027, engine 0.19.0 (Waymark, 2026-10-22; Pulse hostile-initiative.md, the rival crew drawn by the gunfire presses for the Vale holder): walking Vale straight to the car the Enforcer was downed by the crew from behind at 4:11.9. So the cell protects him: as the doors open he holds Vale at the service door, where the Office's west corner is between him and the crew (it stops at its stop point of him, 13 m off, with no line), while the three drop the response unit at the car as before; once it is down the Scout and the Fixer lock the crew and walk across the square to flank it at 10-11 m, inside its own reach, and drive it back (3 hits); then he walks Vale to the car, the Scout and the Fixer walk back to their waits, and the Tech holds the car from his wait, the west pier between him and the café wall officers (briefs/027/waymark/loud-robust-0.19.txt).
